title: Water Damage Mitigation Dispatch Billing Clause: Debris Hauled on the Emergency Dispatch
content:
**Dispatch billing clause — Water Damage Mitigation**

When the job's latest flood cut line is dated the job's opened date, the haul is made on the emergency dispatch and a haul-window multiplier applies to the per-load rate of the tear-out debris haul-off line: 1.5 when the dispatch window is holiday and 1.3 when it is after-hours; in any other case no haul-window multiplier applies.

The dispatch window is the rate window recorded for the job's dispatch; the comparison is between the service date of the latest flood cut line on the job and the opened date on the job record.

## Cases (hypothetical)
| Latest flood cut line dated | Dispatch window | Haul-window multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| the opened date | holiday | 1.5 |
| the opened date | after-hours | 1.3 |
| the opened date | business hours | none |
| a day after the opened date | holiday or after-hours | none |
| the job has no flood cut line | any | none |

A job dispatched on a holiday evening whose drywall was cut the same day carries the multiplier of 1.5; if the last flood cut on that job was made the next morning, no haul-window multiplier applies.
